name: avatar
summary: Identifies a person, team, or integration with an accessible image or initials fallback.

agent.useWhen: A person, team, or integration needs a compact identity marker with a meaningful accessible name, optionally backed by a safely sourced image.
agent.avoidWhen: The image is content rather than an identity marker or needs app behavior beyond a static image with initials fallback.

invariants: Initials and the accessible label are required, nonblank text without control characters; initials contain at most three Unicode grapheme clusters.
imageSource, when supplied, is a credential-free HTTPS URL or a safe /assets/app/ or /assets/instance/ host asset path; unsafe URLs, controls, backslashes and traversal are rejected.

The wrapper is a named role=img; image alt text is empty and hidden from assistive technology while initials remain the accessible fallback and sit beneath the image in CSS, including when loading fails.

Images use no-referrer, lazy loading and asynchronous decoding. The app owns URL acquisition. Native src and initials may use checked whole-field bindings; the host validates their runtime values. The browser loads images normally; the server performs no image fetch, and the component adds no JavaScript or lifecycle behavior.
The component is static and noninteractive and owns no commands or routes.
The fragment has exactly one [[avatar]] slot; the renderer escapes initials, label and imageSource and rejects malformed or unsupported slots.
